description:
Add Snowpark Connect platform adapter for PySpark API compatibility on Snowflake.
This provides a PySpark DataFrame API compatibility layer that executes on
Snowflake's native query engine (not Apache Spark).

Implementation reuses 100% of existing Snowflake credential management and
staging patterns. Users can run PySpark code without a Spark cluster.

Note: Some Spark features unavailable (RDD, hint(), repartition()).
